description: The bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors made by two models—NoR QA (orange bars) and OneR QA (red bars)—across three different datasets: 2WikiMQA, MusiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5. For the 2WikiMQA dataset, NoR QA had 29 errors and OneR QA had 23. In the MusiQue dataset, NoR QA had 28 errors and OneR QA had 27. For the IIRC dataset, NoR QA had 15 errors and OneR QA had 14. The chart also includes a third set of bars, which are blue and have a diagonal line pattern, but these are not labeled in the legend. The data shows that NoR QA consistently made more factual errors than OneR QA across all three datasets.
